name: Urbanway 18M
variant: diesel, 4 doors, series 1 (SAD Zvolen, MHD Banská Bystrica)

livery.description: Delivered in a red and white livery ("červeno-biely náter"), as described by imhd.sk; hex values approximate.

sources.title: Iveco Urbanway 18M – vehicle type description
sources.publisher: imhd.sk (Banská Bystrica public transport information site)

notes: Series 1 (2017, 5 vehicles; 3 sold to DPMP Prešov in 2025). FPT Cursor 9 Euro 6 diesel 265 kW, Voith DIWA.6. Floor 320 mm (door 1), 330 mm (doors 2-3), 340 mm (door 4). Wheelbases 5,355 and 6,675 mm. Standing 97 (91 with a wheelchair). Series 3 mild hybrid (2023): length 18,003 mm, height 3,165 mm, 42 + 1 seats, 106 standing, 148 + 1 total, 1 kWh 48 V battery. Capacity excludes the driver. Two body sections with one articulation (front and rear section joined by a covered joint).
